basis: Explicit scene and speaker formulas, discourse continuity, repeated speech-resumption formulas, poem/list function, and prose/poetry transitions. Canonical relations are evidence only and never authorize theology, identity, chronology, authorship, speaker reallocation, or a preferred textual reading.
proposal_bias: Prefer the larger coherent scene or complete speech. Preserve narrower alternatives rather than atomizing speeches at chapter boundaries.

chunks.seam: Scene setting and habitual household practice close before the heavenly assembly.
Day/assembly and dialogue open at 1:6; permission and departure close at 1:12.

chunks.form: escalating messenger catastrophe chain and response
chunks.seam: New earthly day opens at 1:13; repeated while-he-was-still-speaking reports culminate in Job's response and narrator evaluation.

chunks.form: second heavenly court scene with earthly affliction and spouse exchange
chunks.seam: Repeated assembly formula opens; Job's reply and narrator evaluation close the trial episode.

chunks.form: friends' arrival, recognition, mourning, and silence
chunks.seam: Named friends hear and gather; seven-day silence closes before Job opens his mouth.
Explicit mouth-opening/curse introduction; sustained first-person lament closes before Eliphaz answers.
Explicit Eliphaz answer at 4:1; second-person closing exhortation at 5:27 before Job answers.
Explicit Job answer at 6:1; continuous complaint/appeal closes before Bildad answers.
Explicit Bildad answer and next explicit speaker formula.
Explicit Job answer at 9:1; argument continues across chapter seam through lament before Zophar answers.
Explicit Zophar answer and next explicit Job answer.
Explicit Job answer; sustained address and mortality lament continue across two chapter seams until Eliphaz answers.
Explicit Eliphaz answer and next explicit Job answer.
Explicit Job answer; complaint, witness/appeal language, and hope question continue across chapter seam until Bildad answers.
Explicit Bildad answer and next explicit Job answer.
Explicit Job answer; lament, appeal, witness/redeemer language, and warning remain one turn until Zophar answers.
Explicit Zophar answer and next explicit Job answer.
Explicit Job answer and closing rebuttal before Eliphaz answers.
Explicit Eliphaz answer and next explicit Job answer.
Explicit Job answer at 23:1; first-person search and injustice protest continue across chapter seam until Bildad answers.
Explicit Bildad answer and next explicit Job answer.
Explicit Job answer at 26:1; 27:1 explicitly says Job again took up his parable, so the larger Job turn is retained through 27:23.

chunks.form: wisdom/mining poem with closing fear refrain
chunks.seam: Mining-search discourse begins without a new named-speaker formula and culminates in the wisdom/fear saying; Job's parable restarts explicitly at 29:1.

chunks.form: Job's final recollection, reversal lament, and oath-defense
chunks.seam: 29:1 explicitly restarts Job's parable; 31:40 explicitly ends Job's words.

chunks.form: prose transition introducing Elihu and his anger
chunks.seam: Job's words have ended; narrative explanation runs through Elihu's waiting/anger before direct speech at 32:6.
Elihu's named answer at 32:6 continues into direct address to Job in chapter 33; 34:1 supplies the next explicit answer formula.
Explicit Elihu answer at 34:1 and a new explicit Elihu answer at 35:1.
Explicit Elihu answer at 35:1 and explicit continuation at 36:1.

chunks.form: Elihu continued address with storm and creation catalogue
chunks.seam: Explicit continuation at 36:1; sustained address and storm imagery continue until YHWH answers at 38:1.

chunks.form: YHWH's first whirlwind challenge and creation/nature catalogue
chunks.seam: Explicit whirlwind answer at 38:1; YHWH's questioning continues through 40:2 before Job answers.
Explicit Job answer and closure before the second whirlwind answer.

chunks.form: YHWH's second whirlwind challenge including Behemoth and Leviathan
chunks.seam: Explicit second whirlwind answer at 40:6; divine challenge and creature catalogues continue until Job answers at 42:1.
Explicit Job answer; response closes before prose temporal reset and divine address to Eliphaz.

chunks.form: prose verdict, commanded sacrifice, and intercession
chunks.seam: After-speech temporal reset opens; commanded action is completed and accepted before restoration turn.

chunks.form: prose restoration, household register, and death notice
chunks.seam: Restoration turn at 42:10; gifts, children, years, generations, and death notice close the book.

premortem_holds.risk: Turning the accuser, permission, divine agency, blessing/curse euphemism, or suffering sequence into a causal-theodicy ruling.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep the two scene boundaries provisional and route terminology, agency, and moral inference to qualified Hebrew/textual and human review.

premortem_holds.risk: Forcing a perfectly symmetric three-cycle scheme or silently inventing/reallocating a missing Zophar speech.
premortem_holds.appeal: Retain only explicit speaker formulas; preserve 22:1-27:23 as a larger cycle alternative and leave 24-27 allocation unresolved.

premortem_holds.risk: Letting afterlife, redeemer/witness, or Christological reception determine a seam or translation.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep the phrase inside Job's complete speech; record reception/canonical echoes separately as evidence only.

premortem_holds.risk: Repairing difficult Hebrew or speech allocation by moving verses among Job, Bildad, Zophar, or a narrator.
premortem_holds.appeal: No reallocation. Preserve exact 23-24, 25, 26-27, and 28 candidates plus their larger alternatives for external review.

premortem_holds.risk: Treating distinct literary form as proof of narrator/editor/Job authorship or insertion history.
premortem_holds.appeal: Distinct poem is a form decision only; authorship and compositional history remain unruled.

premortem_holds.risk: Atomizing the oath-defense into doctrinal or moral propositions, or ignoring its explicit final-discourse frame.
premortem_holds.appeal: Prefer the full 29-31 discourse while retaining its three chapter-scale movements as alternatives.

premortem_holds.risk: Splitting Elihu merely by English chapters or deciding the value/authority of Elihu's claims.
premortem_holds.appeal: Use explicit answer/continuation formulas; retain 32:6-37:24 as a larger alternative and leave theological evaluation open.

premortem_holds.risk: Proof-texting individual divine questions, identifying Behemoth/Leviathan, or deriving a final theodicy from boundaries.
premortem_holds.appeal: Preserve complete whirlwind challenges and Job responses; zoological, mythic, moral, and theological identifications remain deferred.

premortem_holds.risk: Settling the disputed force of 42:6 or using the divine verdict as blanket approval/disapproval of every earlier proposition.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep response and prose verdict separate; require Hebrew/textual and discourse review before any translation or theological claim.

premortem_holds.risk: Reading restoration arithmetic, daughters' inheritance, or long life as a universal causal/moral formula.
premortem_holds.appeal: Treat register and closure as narrative form only.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.non_authority: No historic identification, harmonization, agency ruling, or theodicy.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.non_authority: No proposition transfer, speaker endorsement, dating, or doctrinal harmonization.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.basis: witness/redeemer, death, vindication, and later canonical reception pressure
evidence_only_canonical_relations.non_authority: No afterlife or Christological identification and no preferred translation.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.basis: wisdom-search, inaccessibility, value, and fear language
evidence_only_canonical_relations.non_authority: No authorship, dependence, insertion, or theological ruling.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.basis: breath/spirit, mediated correction, and storm/creation language
evidence_only_canonical_relations.non_authority: No authority ranking of Elihu, identity claim, or doctrine.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.basis: creation order, divine questions, creature catalogues, and human limitation
evidence_only_canonical_relations.non_authority: No proof-text fragmentation, creature identification, or final theodicy.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.basis: intercession, reversal/restoration, sacrifice, blessing, and prose closure motifs
evidence_only_canonical_relations.non_authority: No universal prosperity formula, moral calculus, or historical harmonization.
